protocol.name: helix_keybindings_v1

description.summary: global key bindings for the Helix shell

protocol.description:
A private protocol between the Helix compositor and the Helix shell.
GNOME Shell offers global accelerators over D-Bus (org.gnome.Shell.GrabAccelerator), and in GNOME the shell and the compositor are one process. In Helix they are separate, so the shell asks the compositor to bind key combinations with this protocol and relays presses back to D-Bus clients as AcceleratorActivated.
The global is only advertised to privileged clients: the shell process the compositor launched itself on a pre-connected socket (WAYLAND_SOCKET). Ordinary clients cannot see it.

interface.name: helix_keybindings_manager_v1
interface.description: Bound keys are taken away from the focused client: their presses and releases are delivered only as helix_keybinding_v1 events. Shortcuts the compositor handles itself always take precedence.

request.name: bind
request.description: Bind the key named keysym (an XKB keysym name such as "a", "F9" or "XF86AudioMute"), with exactly the given modifiers held. The result is reported with bound or failed on the new object.

entry.name: unknown_key
entry.summary: the keysym name is not known

entry.name: taken
entry.summary: already bound, or reserved by the compositor

event.name: failed

description.summary: the binding could not be made

event.description: The object is inert afterwards; destroy it.

description.summary: the key of the combination was released

request.name: allow_when_locked

description.summary: keep the binding working while locked

request.description: By default a binding does nothing while the session is locked. After this request its presses and releases are delivered while locked too (for volume and brightness keys).
